result.description:
A Private Hospital, Newcastle’s largest and most comprehensive private surgical facility, is seeking an experienced Post Anaesthetic Care Unit professional to step into the role of Clinical Nurse Educator. Situated within an elite health precinct that spans two sites, the practice environment features fourteen modern theatres, a cardiac catheterization lab, and a dedicated intensive care unit. The educator will operate within a sophisticated infrastructure supported by onsite radiology and pathology services, providing the ideal backdrop for driving clinical excellence and innovation. The team composition is highly collaborative, bringing together the region’s leading medical specialists and a dedicated nursing leadership team committed to fostering a culture of continuous learning. 

 The Clinical Nurse Educator serves as a pivotal leader, enjoying significant clinical autonomy while designing and implementing professional development programs. This role is backed by robust administrative and nursing support, ensuring the educator can focus on conducting training needs analyses, completing clinical competency assessments, and facilitating Chronic Disease Management (CDM) education. With a mandate to mentor students, graduates, and new staff, the position offers vast supervisor opportunities and the chance to specialize in adult learning principles. The facility actively encourages the pursuit of special interest opportunities within perioperative nursing, ensuring that its educators remain leaders in the ever-evolving healthcare landscape. 

 Recognizing that excellence is fueled by a supported workforce, the hospital provides extensive Continuing Professional Development (CPD) support, including pathways for supported postgraduate education. The position is offered as a permanent part-time 0.6 FTE role, emphasizing the hospital's commitment to flexible working arrangements and a sustainable work-life balance. In addition to a competitive salary package, staff benefit from a comprehensive wellbeing program that includes discounted private health insurance, paid parental leave, and structured career progression pathways. 

 The lifestyle benefits of the location are truly second-to-none. Centrally located between the vibrant boutiques and cafes of The Junction and the world-renowned surf of Merewether Beach, the facility allows for a seamless blend of professional ambition and coastal relaxation. This is an exceptional opportunity for a motivated clinician with at least five years of experience to join a team that values every individual and uses innovation to drive best practices. The successful candidate will find themselves in a community-focused environment where growth is the standard and extraordinary care is the daily mission.   Apply Now

result.description:
Join MEGT as an Electrical Apprentice! 
 Are you a motivated, reliable and hands-on individual looking to launch your career in the electrical industry? MEGT has a fantastic opportunity with one of our valued clients for an  Electrical Apprenticeship  based in  Port Macquarie, NSW , with work completed across surrounding areas.   
 About the role 
 This apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to develop practical skills and gain hands-on experience in the  domestic electrical industry . You will work alongside experienced electricians while completing a nationally recognised qualification.   You will gain experience in:   
 
 Assisting qualified electricians with a variety of domestic electrical work. 
 Learning the fundamentals of electrical installations, maintenance and repairs. 
 Using and maintaining electrical tools and equipment under supervision. 
 Completing general site support duties while developing practical electrical skills. 
 
 What we're looking for 
 
 Punctual, reliable and motivated, with a strong work ethic and willingness to learn. 
 Strong mathematical ability, with a demonstrated commitment to achieving good results in mathematics. 
 A current White Card is essential. 
 A driver's licence and reliable transport are preferred. 
 Completion of an electrical pre-apprenticeship or relevant technical college course is desirable but not essential. 
 
 Previous experience using hand tools or power tools is not required. The successful candidate will receive training and support and should be willing to listen, follow instructions and learn from the ground up.   
 What can you expect from us? 
 
 Personalised one-on-one mentoring and support throughout your apprenticeship. 
 A nationally recognised qualification. 
 Weekly pay. 
 Comprehensive TAFE training leading to a  Certificate III in Electrotechnology (Electrician) . 
 Hands-on experience across a variety of domestic electrical projects. 
 
 What other benefits? 
 
 Work alongside experienced electricians who will provide practical guidance and support. 
 Gain exposure to a range of domestic electrical work across different job sites. 
 Opportunities to attend industry and social events hosted by electrical wholesalers and suppliers. 
 Build valuable industry connections and a strong foundation for a long-term career in the electrical industry. 
 Potential ongoing employment opportunities upon completion, subject to business requirements and performance. 
 
 About the company 
 Our client is a locally based electrical business operating from  Port Macquarie, NSW , specialising in  domestic electrical work  across surrounding areas. The team provides a supportive, hands-on learning environment where apprentices receive direct guidance and practical experience across a variety of residential projects.   The employer is open to candidates with no previous electrical experience and is committed to teaching the successful apprentice the skills required to build a successful career in the electrical industry. If you are motivated, willing to listen and eager to learn, this could be the opportunity for you.    Please note:  The role involves travelling to different residential job sites. The successful candidate will generally meet the team at the Wauchope workshop at approximately  6:30 am  before travelling to job locations in a company vehicle. Working hours may vary depending on project requirements.    Interested?  Click  "Apply Now"  or visit   https://www.megt.com.au/jobs   for more information.   At MEGT, we enable people to start their careers through Apprenticeships and Traineeships and support large and small businesses to recruit, train and grow careers. Our purpose is to provide life-changing, lifelong learning and employment solutions for all. We invite you to be part of our story. By applying, you agree to receive information about other MEGT employment and education opportunities.   MEGT is committed to being a Child Safe Organisation and an Equal Opportunity Employer. We have zero tolerance for racism, discrimination, harm or abuse. We have a culture that values safety, diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified applicants, including women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, veterans and individuals from diverse backgrounds, to apply.

Full-time Cabinet Maker position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team  in Sydney NSW. 

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Cabinet Maker
•	Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Must be qualified or have experience (min 2 yrs) in the industry. 

About Us
Sublime Custom Cabinetry Pty Ltd is a Sydney-based custom joinery and cabinetry business. The company specialises in the design, manufacture, and installation of high-end, bespoke cabinetry for both residential and commercial clients across the Northern Beaches and greater Sydney region.

About the role
The Cabinet Maker constructs, assembles, and installs high-quality custom cabinetry and architectural joinery. The role requires working from detailed shop drawings to produce precise residential and commercial fit-outs. The Cabinet Maker ensures all work meets the quality standards of Sublime Custom Cabinetry Pty Ltd. The role involves both workshop manufacturing and on-site installation.

Duties and Responsibilities

?	Work from CAD drawings and cutting lists.
?	Select, measure, cut, and shape timber, MDF, particleboard, laminates, and veneers.
?	Safely operate workshop machinery including panel saws, edge banders, thicknessers, and CNC routers.
?	Glue, fit, and clamp parts and sub-assemblies together to form complete units.
?	Install hinges, drawer runners, handles, and specialized joinery hardware.
?	Sand surfaces, apply edge banding, and prepare products for final finishing or polishing.
?	Protect client property and prepare the installation area.
?	Securely install cabinetry, benchtops, and joinery items on site.
?	Scribe filler panels and kickboards to fit uneven walls and floors perfectly.
?	Identify and rectify any fitment issues or defects during the installation process.
?	Remove all debris, offcuts, and packaging from the site upon completion.
?	Perform routine maintenance on hand tools, power tools, and workshop machinery.

Essential Skills

?	A strong commitment to producing flawless, high-end finishes.
?	Ability to work collaboratively with apprentices, tradespeople, and management.
?	Capability to meet strict production deadlines without compromising quality.
?	Physically fit

Qualifications needed:

?	Minimum Trade certificate qualification or equivalent relevant work experience
?	Minimum two years of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

?	Competitive salary based on experience
?	Opportunities for professional growth and training
?	A supportive and dynamic work environment
?	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $70,000-$90,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

result.description: True Protein   About the role:   We’re looking for an experienced Production Operations Supervisor to oversee daily operations, train and manage a small team, and help bring our new automated facility at Braeside to life. This factory and role would be working under the True Protein’s group of companies.  You’ll be working in a clean, modern environment with a new CP6000 canning machine at its heart. No expense has been spared to create a small, efficient plant that just needs your special skills to help keep it running at full speed to produce an innovative new drink, produced right here in Australia.   What your day to day will look like:    Oversee daily production operations and ensuring output targets are achieved  Manage and monitor all operating machinery, ensuring optimal performance and uptime  Supervise and coordinate the packing line, robotic and pallet wrapping systems to maintain efficiency and product quality  Conduct staff training and development activities (where capability permits) to build team skills and compliance  Provide hands-on operational cover during staff breaks and absences across all production areas  Ensure all workplace health and safety protocols are followed on the production floor  Communicate effectively with Management regarding production progress, staffing issues, and equipment status  Assist with quality control checks and production reporting as required  Manage rosters, leave, and recruitment  Provide hands-on operational cover during staff breaks and absences to maintain continuous flow  Ensure compliance with food safety regulations, WHS standards, and environmental requirements  Report regularly to senior management on performance, challenges, and improvement opportunities   This role is perfect for someone who takes initiative, share ideas, and want to be part of something new. If you’re the kind of person who thrives when given real ownership and wants to see the direct results of your work, you’ll fit right in.         Benefits   What’s In It for You:    Competitive salary package  A modern semi-automated production facility  Supportive and collaborative environment  Opportunity to work with an innovative Australian manufacturing business with career progression opportunities       Task & responsibilities   Oversee daily production operations and ensuring output targets are achieved  Manage and monitor all operating machinery, ensuring optimal performance and uptime  Supervise and coordinate the packing line, robotic and pallet wrapping systems to maintain efficiency and product quality  Conduct staff training and development activities (where capability permits) to build team skills and compliance  Provide hands-on operational cover during staff breaks and absences across all production areas  Ensure all workplace health and safety protocols are followed on the production floor  Communicate effectively with Management regarding production progress, staffing issues, and equipment status  Assist with quality control checks and production reporting as required  Manage rosters, leave, and recruitment    Qualification & experience   Qualifications in Engineering and or Supply Chain Management  12 months minimum work experience in a related field is required  Hands-on experience in food or beverage manufacturing management  Comfortable operating and maintaining automated processing and packaging machinery  A natural leader who builds capable, motivated teams  Familiarity with food safety standards (HACCP, GMP) and WHS legislation  Sharp problem-solver who reads the data and drives real improvements  Flexible — happy to step in and assist across all operational areas when needed  Current forklift licence (desirable)   About Company     About True:   At True, we're on a mission to create a world of healthier people.  True Protein was born out of a desire to empower our community in living energetic and fulfilled lives. Since 2014, we have pioneered a new standard in health and performance products, delivering natural, authentic and transparent products without compromise.   This all begins within our own True Team, a high performing group of like-minded individuals who truly believe in and strive to embody our company values in all that we do, both in our personal and professional lives. Australian owned but looking to conquer the world, we are continuously growing our team with creative and community-minded people.
